about: The golden transcripts in ../golden were recorded from the ORIGINAL RivetIT code (baseline c26957c0b). The five files below were re-recorded through RivetCore 1.0.0-rc.7 because of the CORE-1 security fix (enrollment is bound to the token's client). ../golden-original holds the pre-fix recordings of exactly those five files. tests/Unit/Rmm/GoldenDeltaTest.php proves that the ONLY exchanges and snapshot tables that differ between ../golden-original and ../golden are the units listed here; everything else in the five files, and the other five files, are byte-identical to the original wire protocol.

reasons.CORE-1: Step 'serial-of-known-device-with-other-department-token': the Department B enrollment token presents the machine_guid and serial of the Department A (client 1) device GOLD-EC6A. The original code reused that device (a reinstall: 201 with the Department A device_id, install_id and enrollment token row overwritten, enroll_count 2, reason 'reinstalled'). Core now never reuses a device of another client: it creates a NEW device of the token's client (2) in pending_approval with match_reason 'cross_client_identity' (201, a different device_id) and the Department A device keeps its install_id, credential and enroll_count 1. Status codes, headers and body keys are unchanged; only the device_id differs.
reasons.CORE-1-renumbering: Knock-on of CORE-1 only: the new cross-client device is the first unnamed device, so later unnamed devices are masked <DEVICE#2> instead of <DEVICE#1>. No behaviour of that exchange changed.
reasons.CORE-1-device-rows: Knock-on of CORE-1 only: the endpoint_agent_devices snapshot gains the cross-client device row and the Department A device row is no longer overwritten (install_id ...0003 instead of ...0013, enroll_count 1, enrolled_via_token_id TOKENROW#1). Later device rows are unchanged apart from the <DEVICE#n> renumbering.
reasons.CORE-1-attempts: Knock-on of CORE-1 only: endpoint_agent_enroll_attempts_by_reason counts one more 'enrolled' attempt (7 instead of 6) and one fewer 'reinstalled' (2 instead of 3), the same exchange recorded under its new reason.
